name: ac-telemetry
install:
set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get update
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y python3-venv tesseract-ocr
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e '.[capture,ocr,dev]' 'pytest>=8.3'
start:
set -euo pipefail
if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8741/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ac-telemetry already healthy on :8741"
  exit 0
fi
exec .venv/bin/ac-telemetry --backend mock --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8741
